info.text:
Diesel costs 71% more than a year ago, per AAA.
AAA: national average about $6.28 a gallon, after a record $6.53 on Sept 22. EIA's weekly record was $6.529 (week of Sept 21, 2026).
Oct 9: Trump announced a diesel deal with Putin; Treasury waived sanctions on Russian diesel through April 2027.
Oct 10: Russia partly lifted its diesel export ban (about 500,000 tons).
Oct 11: Trump said Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire (a similar claim in September didn't stop strikes); Moscow had not confirmed and Zelensky called it "news for me."
Sources: EIA, AAA, CNBC, Fortune, CNN, AFP, Kyiv Independent.
News and education, not financial advice.
